name: MCPJam Backend LLM paid spend >$400/h (ladder 3, SEV)
aplQuery: | extend event=extract('"event":"([^"]+)"', 1, msg), spendingKey=extract('"spendingKey":"([^"]+)"', 1, msg), spendingPolicy=extract('"spendingPolicy":"([^"]+)"', 1, msg), modelSource=extract('"modelSource":"([^"]+)"', 1, msg), totalCost=todouble(extract('"totalCost":([0-9.]+)', 1, msg)), additionalCost=todouble(extract('"additionalCostToCharge":([0-9.]+)', 1, msg))
description: SEV · MCPJam-paid LLM spend passed $400 in the last hour — a day on track for >$5k. Normal is under $50.
1. Triage as for the $150 rung, which has already fired (same query, one click below).
2. Is the newest containment fix actually in PROD, not just merged?
3. Kill switches, no deploy needed: FREE_BUCKET_MODEL_GATE, FREE_BUCKET_MAX_OUTPUT_USD_PER_M,
rationale: WHY THIS EXISTS: the existing 'spend velocity' page fires at $50/h and then goes quiet. This is the next rung: a real bleed crosses $50, then $150, then $400 and gets a fresh message at each rung. Three messages in an hour that keep escalating is the shape of an incident; one message at $50 is a busy afternoon.

WHY THIS THRESHOLD: measured hourly MCPJam-paid spend 2026-08-25..09-12 (legit): p95 of the hourly max per day <= $44, absolute max $50.4 (08-28). Early-abuse days 09-13/14 peaked at $69/$52 (only the $50 rung should fire). 09-15 peaked at $604-$804/h. $150 = 3x legit max; $400 = the level at which a day is on track for >$5k.

CONTEXT (2026-09-15 incident): $5,187 of MCPJam-paid spend in one UTC day. Every existing spend monitor fired correctly and posted to #mcpjam-alerts, but each is a single fixed threshold that notifies ONCE on crossing (Axiom threshold monitors only notify on state change; there is no re-notify while open). The daily page said '$107 is above $100' and then stayed silent while the day climbed to $5k, in a channel that also carries Sentry/PostHog/BE5 noise. Fan-out abuse (thousands of minted guests spending $1-3 each) moved the SPENDER COUNT 5-10x before the dollars did. This monitor set adds (a) a ladder of escalating spend tiers so a big day produces escalating messages, and (b) fan-out signals that lead the dollars.
SCOPE: only MCPJam's money — spendingPolicy=consume_mcpjam_limit AND modelSource=mcpjam. BYOK / record_only never cost us and are excluded (the older 'spend velocity' monitors sum everything).
